item.title: Friday the 13th legend coming to Fall River on, you guessed it, Friday the 13th
item.description: On Friday, March 13th, horror icon Kane Hodder, best known for portraying Jason Voorhees in the Friday the 13th film franchise and who has hundreds of movie/tv credits to his name, will host an exclusive fan meet & greet inside the historic Lizzie Borden House in Fall River. item.description: Multiple crashes led to the shutdown of an area road, multiple injuries, and a fuel spill.
